[TAB]A secret council that is so good at spreading lies that it is often unaware of the truth of its own stories. They have "thrones" (secret meeting places) in most major cities and excel at sneaking goods and people into or out of areas. Esus is known as the King of Thieves, Jack Shadow, and Moonsong, though it's popular for religious leaders to take these names for themselves as well. [PARAGRAPH:2]Founding[PARAGRAPH]This is the most common legend spread about the founding of the religion. No one knows if it's actually true. [PARAGRAPH]Unknown to the other gods, Esus slips into creation from time to time. Most commonly as a traveling minstrel (male or female as it suits him), but occasionally as a merchant, beggar, jackal or crow. [PARAGRAPH]On one of these trips he met Oriol Peregrinus, a priest of Kilmorph who had been stealing from his temple for years. The night before he was to go face trial he sat in a bar drinking and whispering prayers to any god that would hear him, as his own certainly wouldn't forgive his crime. [PARAGRAPH]Esus, who was playing at the bar, overheard him and went to comfort the man. The two shared drinks and eventually Oriol shared his story. Esus offered a lie that Oriol could tell to the church, but Oriol was still worried that he wouldn't be believed. At that Esus offered him an opal scarab that would make anyone believe his lies. [PARAGRAPH]Oriol took the scarab and went to his trial before the church elders. To his surprise, they believed his lies without question. Those that accused him were punished and it increased his standing in the church of Kilmorph. [PARAGRAPH]A year later Esus returned and found Oriol at the bar again. This time he was ruined, he barely had the money to pay for his drink and had lost everything in the world that mattered to him. Esus asked what was wrong and he said that no one believed anything he said. He thought the scarab was cursed and threw it away. [PARAGRAPH]Esus explained that he had made the man's lies believable, but at a cost that no one would believe anything Oriol said that was true. If Oriol told his wife he loved her, she wouldn't believe him. [PARAGRAPH]Oriol sobbed into his drink. [PARAGRAPH]"What is your name?" Esus asked. [PARAGRAPH]"Oriol. " Oriol said, still staring into his drink. [PARAGRAPH]"I don't believe you. " Esus said. "I think your name is Mendax Opacous. "[PARAGRAPH]"My name is Mendax?" Oriol asked. [PARAGRAPH]"That sounds better. That is a name people will believe. " Esus said. "And what god do you worship? Surely not Kilmorph, I think you worship Esus, the god of shadows. "[PARAGRAPH]"I worship the god of shadows?" Oriol asked. [PARAGRAPH]"Yes you do. See how easy this is. " Esus said. "And remember that you can tell any woman you love her, and she will believe you. As long as it isn't true. If you actually love her then your words will be sour to her ears, your affections will poison her against you. You can go to a new city, start a new life, raise up a church to Esus, as long as you know that it is all pretend. "[PARAGRAPH]"I have already lost my wife's love to your curse. " Oriol said. "I have lost my standing in the church, you should have me abandon my faith as well? What if I just go to church elders and tell them about what you have done to me?"[PARAGRAPH]"You could try, but who would believe you?" Esus said with a smile. [PARAGRAPH]Oriol, now going by Mendax, did as Esus suggested and founded the first Aphotic Throne in an abandoned Patrian manor (it was easy enough to convince them that he was the real owner). The traditions of that throne were largely made up by him in a tangled weave of whatever inspiration struck him in the moment. It was said that his biggest secret was that he kept a small shrine of Kilmorph until the day he died. [PARAGRAPH:3]Sects[PARAGRAPH]Every Throne could be considered its own sect. There is no common communication, rules or traditions between them. Some are brutal and vengeful, others are lighthearted and free. They tend to be the opposite of the communities they exist in. Sometimes they are the secret power behind the city government, and sometimes they are teenage adventurers pretending at being a secret organization. [PARAGRAPH:3]An oddity among the religions, the Council of Esus has no temples or ordinary disciples. As a secret society, it cannot be [LINK=SPELL_EVANGELIZE]Evangelized[\LINK] openly to either cities or all the units nearby. However, any unit which is a member can pay to establish a local Council presence in any city. Units without another State Religion prerequisite, and with a leader with the right State Religion, can spend gold to purchase an initiation from an Esus [LINK=PROMOTION_EVANGELIZE]Evangelist[\LINK] on the same plot. That theme, paying for miracles, is common in the Council of Esus. [PARAGRAPH]Esus's priests have the abilities of Spies, including the ability to steal plans, destroy city production, and sabotage improvements including even Unique Features. [PARAGRAPH]State Religion allows access to the [LINK=UNIT_SHADOWRIDER]Shadowrider[\LINK], [LINK=UNIT_DISCIPLE_ESUS]Swindler [\LINK], [LINK=UNIT_PRIEST_ESUS]Thief[\LINK], and [LINK=UNIT_HIGH_PRIEST_ESUS]Propogandist[\LINK] units. [PARAGRAPH]The Council of Esus has major conflicts with The Empyrean. One may prevent the spread of another into a city, or drive the other out. [PARAGRAPH]The Council of Esus was the driving force behind the founding of the Undercouncil in opposition to the Overcouncil. No player may adopt the Undercouncil civic until this religion is founded, nor may any player with this state religion join the Overcouncil. 
		
		
		
[PARAGRAPH:3]Priests and Angels of [LINK=RELIGION_COUNCIL_OF_ESUS]The Council of Esus[\LINK] will have their ardas most strengthened by the influence of [LINK=RELIGION_COUNCIL_OF_ESUS]The Council of Esus[\LINK], but also strengthened to a lesser degree by [LINK=RELIGION_STEWARDS_OF_INEQUITY]The Stewards of Inequity[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_ANOINTED]The Anointed[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_COVEN]The Between[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_THE_ASHEN_VEIL]The Ashen Veil[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_SONS_OF_DISCORD]The Sons of Discord[\LINK], and [LINK=RELIGION_EMBER_LEGION]The Ember Legion[\LINK]. Its arda will be weakened by [LINK=RELIGION_CHILDREN_OF_THE_ONE]The Children of The One[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_MATRONAE]The Matronae[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_THE_EMPYREAN]The Empyrean[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_GREY_COUNCIL]The Grey Council[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_UNBLEMISHED]The Unblemished[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_RINGGIVER]The Ringgivers[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_THE_EMPYREAN]The Order[\LINK], the [LINK=RELIGION_RUNES_OF_KILMORPH]The Runes of Kilmorph[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_CULT_OF_THE_DRAGON]Cult of the Dragon[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_HOUSE_OF_PLENTY]The House of Plenty[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_BROTHERHOOD_OF_WARDENS]The Brotherhood of Wardens[\LINK], and [LINK=RELIGION_FELLOWSHIP_OF_LEAVES]The Fellowship of the Leaves[\LINK]. It will be weakened in Good lands, strengthened in Neutral or Evil lands.It will be strengthened by proximity to [LINK=BONUS_MANA_SHADOW]Shadow Mana[\LINK], [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_WODES_OAK]Wode's Oak[\LINK], and the [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_WHISPERING_WOOD]Whispering Wood[\LINK], It is weakened by [LINK=BONUS_MANA_SUN]Sun Mana[\LINK], the [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_MIRROR_OF_HEAVEN]Mirror of Heaven[\LINK], and [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_CITADEL_OF_LIGHT]Citadels of Light[\LINK].

Judges sought out to adjudicate between different parties. Their religion preaches against bias and imparts decisions without local or personal influence. Mechanic: The Grey Council is a voting body where the player can participate in elections with other players. Often called the Adjudicator.


[PARAGRAPH][ICON_BULLET]Priests and Angels of [LINK=RELIGION_GREY_COUNCIL]The Grey Council[\LINK] will have its arda strengthened by the influence of [LINK=RELIGION_GREY_COUNCIL]The Grey Council[\LINK]. Its arda will be weakened by [LINK=RELIGION_CHILDREN_OF_THE_ONE]The Children of The One[\LINK], [LINK=RELIGION_MATRONAE]The Matronae[\LINK], and [LINK=RELIGION_CULT_OF_THE_DRAGON]Cult of the Dragon[\LINK]. It will be strengthened in Neutral lands and weakened in Good or Evil lands. It will be strengthened by proximity to [LINK=BONUS_MANA_FORCE]Force Mana[\LINK], [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_SEVEN_PINES]the Seven Pines[\LINK], or [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_RING_OF_WARDING]Rings of Warding[\LINK].
